text: This solution, Climate and Disaster Resilience Enhancement Program (Subprogram 1) (CDREP-S1) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Pakistan between Government of Pakistan, Asian Development Bank (ADB), Domestic and international private investors, Insurance sector, and Agriculture stakeholders. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
